title: The Lost Little Seahorse
summary: When some playful bubbles carry him far from home, a little seahorse discovers that the ocean is full of friends ready to help.

scenes.text: Marino was a small and curious seahorse. He lived among the colorful corals, swaying with the gentle waves. That afternoon, spinning with joy, floating up and down, he went chasing after some shiny bubbles. They carried him farther and farther, all the way to a garden of corals he had never seen before. When Marino looked around, he no longer recognized anything. Where was his home? The little seahorse felt a nervous tickle in his tummy, but he took a deep breath and decided to be brave.

Suddenly, an orange fish appeared among the seaweed. "Don't cry, little one," he said in a sweet voice. "I will help you find your home." The fish swam beside him and asked what his house was like. Marino remembered: "There is a pink coral, and at night it shines under the moon." The fish smiled. "I know someone who watches it every night. Follow me." Together they swam through swaying plants, while a school of silvery fish waved hello with a wink.

They swam for a long while until they reached a deeper, darker sea. Marino moved close to his new friend, feeling a little scared. Then, from the blue depths, there appeared an enormous whale. She had kind eyes and a soft, deep voice. "Are you lost, little ones?" she asked. "We are looking for the pink coral," answered Marino. She smiled. "Climb onto my back. I will carry you closer." Marino and the fish settled in, and the giant glided slowly, rocking them like a cradle over the calm water.

As the giant swam, the sky above the sea turned orange and then deep blue. One by one, the stars began to peek out, and the sea filled with light. "Look!" said Marino. "From my home I can see that star." The giant stopped beside a familiar reef. In the distance, among the soft shadows, Marino spotted a pink coral swaying with the current. Marino felt a happy little leap inside his heart. "It's here! I'm almost home!"

Marino hugged his giant friend goodbye and swam toward the pink coral. There his family was waiting, and they hugged him tight, so happy to see him. The orange fish stayed for dinner and became his friend forever. Tired and happy, Marino curled up among the warm corals and closed his eyes. Outside, the sea shone calm beneath the moon. One after another, softly sang the waves. "Good night," Marino whispered. And rocked by the sea, the little seahorse fell fast asleep.
